answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the lotus of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on deterministic state transitions verified by pseudo-random validator committees. Written in a analytical prose structured with explicit logical operators and causality register, it stays short. The haven holds work receipts rather than names, so the relic of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
